observations: Two orange/yellow metal cylinders shown, consistent with LPG (cooking) gas cylinders.
A coil of orange hose labeled 'FLAME GAS HIGH QUALITY ORIGINAL' is wrapped around the top cylinder.
Surface shows scuffing, faded paint and some rust-colored staining, consistent with used condition.
No valve, regulator, or neck fitting is visible in either photo.
No capacity/size markings (e.g., kg rating), manufacturer stamp, or test/inspection date is legible in either photo.
Cylinders are photographed outdoors on a concrete surface, partly obscured by the hose coil and background clutter (boxes, metal rack).

claims.claim: Tokunbo gas cylinder (used/second-hand, implies imported used)
claims.evidence: Surface wear in photo 0 and photo 1 is consistent with use, but 'tokunbo' as an origin/quality claim cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

claims.claim: Implied working condition (sold as a usable gas cylinder)
claims.evidence: No valve or seal is visible in either photo to assess leak risk or fitting compatibility.

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity/size (e.g., 3kg, 6kg, 12.5kg, 50kg) is unknown, which drives most of the price.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the stamped capacity/size marking on the cylinder shoulder or body.
risks.if_unproven: Cannot be priced at all without this; size category must be confirmed first.

risks.risk: Valve and threading condition unknown; could be damaged, corroded, or incompatible with standard regulators.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the valve/neck assembly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing valve replacement/repair (worst case).

risks.risk: No visible test/inspection or manufacture date stamp; cylinder could be expired or unsafe for refill under NMDPRA rules.
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped manufacture/test date on the cylinder collar.

risks.risk: Rust or dents may indicate structural weakness not fully visible due to hose coil covering parts of the body.
risks.proof: Full unobstructed photos of the entire cylinder body from multiple angles without the hose wrapped around it.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically and structurally compromised (worst case).

risks.risk: Leak integrity cannot be assessed remotely.
risks.proof: A video clip showing a soap-water leak test on the valve and seams.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not verified leak-free (worst case, i.e., as if not working).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the capacity/size stamp on the cylinder (critical for price category).
Close-up of the valve and neck fitting.
Close-up of the manufacture/test date stamp.
Full-body photos from multiple angles without the hose obscuring the surface.
A short video of a soap-water leak test on the valve.
response.reason: The cylinder's capacity, which is the primary driver of price for a gas cylinder, is not legible in either photo, and the valve/condition details needed even for a worst-case price are not visible.
